note='\n### Post-fix bounded G01 job submitted; Look census A completed\n\n'
note+='708092 (gen_train_metadata_revalidate_01) submitted after plan8f974d5 push: oneGPU, Express/autox, no host,1630s ceiling, same six training scenes/concurrency6. note+='Actual-or-reserved chargedGPUh (pending walltime ceilings retained): '+json.dumps(b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],sort_keys=True)+'; shared '+str(b['accounted_or_reserved_total'])+'/60.\n'
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write(note)
print('POST_FIX_SUBMISSION_AND_CENSUS_A: '+json.dumps({'job':'708092.hopper-m-02','a_result':ar,'a_accounting':account_ref,'budget':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'shared':b['accounted_or_reserved_total']},sort_keys=True))
